# Page 1^page=1
Contributions Download Data Key Field Position Field Name Field Description Nullable A Filing Entity Id The unique id assigned to the reporting candidate or Committee by Idaho Sunshine. No B Filing Entity Name The Name of the Reporting Candidate or Committee. No C Campaign Name The Name of the Reporting Candidate’s Campaign or the Abbreviated Name of the Reporting Committee. Yes D Registration Type This is the type of registration for the reporting Entity, such as Candidate, Political Committee, or Central Committee. No E Transaction Id The unique id assigned to the transaction by Idaho Sunshine. No F Transaction Type The type of transaction being reported, such as a contribution or a loan received. No G Transaction Subtype The subtype of the transaction being reported, such as Itemized Contribution, Unitemized Contribution, In-Kind Contribution, Interest Earned, Anonymous Contribution, and Returned Contribution. Yes H Contributor Type The type of Contributor or Loan Source, such as Person, Company, Self, Candidate, Political Committee, Central Committee. Anonymous Contributions and Interest Earned will not have a contributor type nor a contributor. Yes I Contributor Last Name The Last Name of the Contributor or Lender as reported by the filing entity. If the contributor or lender is a company, political committee, or central committee, the name will be displayed here. Yes J Contributor First Name The First Name of the Contributor or Lender as reported by the filing entity. If the contributor or lender is a company, political committee, or central committee, the first name will be blank. Yes K Contributor Address Line 1 Contributor Address Line 1 as reported by the filing entity. Yes L Contributor Address Line 2 Contributor Address Line 2 as reported by the filing entity. Yes M Contributor Address City Contributor Address City as reported by the filing entity. Yes N Contributor Address State Contributor Address State as reported by the filing entity. Yes O Contributor Address Zip Code Contributor Address Zip Code as reported by the filing entity. Yes P Transaction Date The Transaction Date refers to the date that the contribution or loan was received. No

# Page 2^page=2
Q Transaction Amount The amount of the contribution or loan received. If the transaction dollar amount is listed in parenthesis, then the contribution was returned. No R Loan Interest Amount The amount of interest incurred with the loan. This field will be blank for contributions. Yes S Total Loan Amount The sum of the loan amount and the loan interest amount. This field will be blank for contributions. T Election Type The Election Type indicates which specific election the contribution/loan received was collected for. This field will be blank for committees. Yes U Election Year The Election Year indicates which election year the contribution/loan received was collected towards. This field will be blank for committees. Yes V Transaction Description Any additional information reported about the transaction, for example, an in-kind contribution will list the description of the non-money item. Yes W Amended Amended contains Y if an amendment was filed for this record or a N if an amendment was not filed for this record. Yes X Timed Report Name The timed report name containing the transaction. This field will be blank if the transaction does not meet the threshold requirements. Yes Y Timed Report Filed Date The date the timed report was filed containing the transaction. Yes Z Report Name The disclosure report containing the transaction. No AA Report Filed Date The date the disclosure report was filed containing the transaction. No
